Title: Buyer places a bank transfer order
Preconditions: Buyer logged in with confirmed email; Linen Wrap Dress size M in stock
Steps: 1. Open Linen Wrap Dress 2. Choose size M and click Add to Cart 3. Open Checkout 4. Fill recipient, phone 0771234567, address, city 5. Choose Bank Transfer 6. Click Place Order
Expected Result: Confirmation page 'Thank you for your order!' shows MIVO bank name, account name, account number, reference MIVO-XXXXXXXX and total LKR 6,850.00 (6,450 + 400 delivery); stock of size M drops by 1

Title: Cart price tampering is ignored
Preconditions: Buyer logged in; item in cart
Steps: 1. In browser storage change the cart price of the item to 1 2. Place Order
Expected Result: Order is not placed at the fake price: buyer is told the price changed and the cart is updated to the real price; no order row created at LKR 1

Title: Buyer uploads a valid bank slip
Steps: 1. Open the order page 2. Upload test-data/valid-slip.png 3. Submit
Expected Result: Slip saved; admin Orders page shows 'View slip'; slip opens for the buyer and the admin

Title: Fake slip is rejected
Steps: 1. Upload test-data/fake-slip.jpg (a text file renamed .jpg) 2. Submit
Expected Result: Upload refused with an 'image only' error; nothing saved; order still has no slip

Title: Another user cannot open a buyer's slip
Preconditions: Order with slip from TC-04; second buyer and a boutique account
Steps: 1. Copy the slip link from the buyer's order page 2. Open it logged in as a different buyer 3. Open it logged in as a boutique 4. Open it logged out
Expected Result: All three get Not found / login redirect; the image is never returned

Title: Admin verifies a bank transfer
Preconditions: TC-01 order unpaid; admin logged in
Steps: 1. Admin > Orders 2. Click Verify payment on the order
Expected Result: Payment shows Paid; buyer gets 'payment confirmed' email; the boutique gets 'New order' email with its items; Activity log shows 'Verified payment'

Title: Verify payment twice has no double effect
Preconditions: TC-01 order unpaid; two admin browser tabs open on Admin > Orders
Steps: 1. Click Verify payment in tab A 2. Click Verify payment in tab B (stale page)
Expected Result: Tab B gets an error or no change; boutique receives exactly one 'New order' email; one activity log entry

Title: Boutique dispatches a COD package with a MIVO COD courier
Preconditions: Koombiyo set up with MIVO account and COD ticked; Domex not ticked; COD order for Mivo Test Boutique
Steps: 1. Seller > Orders 2. Open courier list 3. Choose Koombiyo 4. Enter tracking KB123456 5. Tick 'I booked it on MIVO's account' 6. Mark as Dispatched
Expected Result: List shows Koombiyo but not Domex; info box shows MIVO account number, reference and COD amount; package moves to On the way; buyer emailed the tracking number

Title: Server refuses a non-COD courier for a COD package
Steps: 1. Send the dispatch request with Domex's courier ID (edit the form in DevTools or replay the request)
Expected Result: Refused: 'This is a cash-on-delivery package: it must be booked on MIVO's account...'; package stays Preparing

Title: Buyer cancels before dispatch
Preconditions: Bank transfer order, nothing dispatched; buyer logged in
Steps: 1. My orders > open order 2. Click Cancel order and confirm
Expected Result: Order Cancelled; all items back in stock; boutique emailed not to ship; if already paid, a refund appears under Admin > Orders > Refunds due

Title: Buyer cannot cancel after dispatch
Preconditions: Order whose package is dispatched; buyer has the order page open from before dispatch
Steps: 1. Click Cancel order on the stale page
Expected Result: Refused with a message to contact MIVO; order and package unchanged; Cancel button gone after reload

Title: Boutique corrects a tracking number
Steps: 1. Seller > Orders > On the way 2. Click Edit tracking 3. Change to KB222222 4. Save
Expected Result: Saved as KB222222; buyer emailed the corrected number; saving again with no change sends no email

Title: Tracking cannot be edited after delivery or by another boutique
Steps: 1. Send updateTracking for the delivered package as the owner 2. Send it for a dispatched package as a different boutique
Expected Result: 1: refused 'already delivered'. 2: refused 'Package not found'. Nothing changes

Title: Admin cannot pay a boutique twice
Preconditions: Boutique has a payable balance and bank details; two admin tabs on Admin > Payouts
Steps: 1. Click Mark as Paid in tab A 2. Click Mark as Paid in tab B (stale amount)
Expected Result: Exactly one payout row; tab B refused because the amount changed; paid items linked to one payout only
